name: czrecoil_frame_update_cd_audio_cmd_ui
description: CZRecoilFrame::OnUpdateCDAudioCmdUI enables and checks the CD-audio command UI from the zSnd option.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x431920 yet; the handler currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x431920 validates Enable(TRUE), GetCDAudioOption, and SetCheck(option != 0).
The native smoke enables CD audio through the toggle handler, then verifies OnUpdateCDAudioCmdUI enables and checks the command UI.
